description: This file contains shell script code for testing various git push scenarios, including push, atomic push, non-fast-forward push, forced push, and cleanup operations, with detailed output formatting and reference management.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for a specific git push scenario.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure for a specific git push scenario.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares git references with expected references.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output to make it user-friendly and stable.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats and saves expected output for comparison.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters output to remove non-essential differences for comparison.
